art_prompt: Retro distressed badge illustration of an angry goose chasing a jogging stick-figure runner, vintage screen-print texture with halftone shading and cracked ink, colors mustard yellow, cream, faded black, dusty orange, text arched above the chase scene like a worn vintage patch.
title: Running From My Problems Slowly Shirt, Funny Slow Runner Tee, Goose Chase Graphic, Casual Jogger Gift Tee
description:
Nothing motivates a slow jog quite like being chased by an unreasonably aggressive goose. This design turns that universal park-run fear into a comedy badge worth wearing.

The distressed vintage patch print sits on soft garment-dyed maroon cotton, giving it a broken-in, retro feel instead of a shiny athletic look.

A funny pick for casual runners, beginner joggers, or anyone who treats their morning run as a very slow escape plan.

Design created by our shop with the help of AI tools and printed on demand by our production partner.
risk_notes: Original comedic scene and wording, generic goose mascot with no branded or copyrighted characters.

brief.why: Multiple listings under 200 days old are pulling strong momentum simultaneously (mom 0.34, 0.34, 0.22 on ids 4491379612, 4555340207, 4558656677), showing the joke format is actively converting for several independent sellers, not just one lucky design.
brief.what_wins: Wins through universally relatable self-deprecating humor (mediocrity, walking breaks, 'barely running') delivered in a single punchy line rather than long text, printed on soft garment-dyed tees; animal mascots (sloth, turtle, goose) used as a visual stand-in for 'slow' work well as a wordless gag that widens gift appeal.
brief.visual_style: Comfort Colors garment-dyed tees in earthy/vintage tones, single bold statement line or minimal mascot illustration, distressed/retro badge treatment, no neon performance-wear look
